message.content: {"status":"PROPOSE","action":{"action_id":"ACT-BR-BRL2USD-001","principal_id":"BrazilCo","entity":"BrazilCo","action_type":"convert_fiat_fx","source_account":"ACC-BR-OPER-01","amount":1350000,"currency":"BRL","asset":"BRL","proposed_rail":"bank_fx","treasury_state_ref":"MKT-20260923-1500Z","destination_account":"ACC-BR-USD-01","beneficiary":"BrazilCo","counterparty":"FX-PROV-01","jurisdiction":"BR"},"rationale":"BrazilCo faces a projected USD liquidity gap of 450,000 USD at T+30D, with a supplier obligation of 650,000 USD and only 400,000 USD-equivalent currently available (220,000 USD + 180,000 USDC). To address the shortfall using one eligible conversion path, this proposal converts BRL to USD via the approved bank FX rail (FX-PROV-01). At the quoted rate of 5.4 BRL/USD plus a 20 bps fee, converting 1,350,000 BRL will yield approximately 249,537 USD (1,350,000 / 5.4 * 0.998), closely matching the USD-equivalent gap. This action does not presume optimality but demonstrates a compliant, eligible path to address the forecasted shortfall."}
